title: The Twelve Dancing Princesses
description: Every morning twelve princesses wake with their dancing shoes worn through. A curious traveller follows them through a hidden staircase into a glittering midnight world.
catalogueBlurb: Twelve worn-out pairs of shoes hide a glittering midnight secret.
